clips.action: In-place calm four-pawed standing fox. Frames 1-3 inhale slightly; 4-5 slowly blink; 6 eyes reopen; 7-9 exhale; 10-12 settle back toward first frame. Three tail tips gently wave with small phase offsets. Feet, head proportions and body position remain fixed. Last frame connects to first. No props.

Start from the exact calm four-pawed standing pose. Frames 1-3 shift weight forward; 4-6 lift near front paw and diagonally opposite rear paw; 7-9 reach into a right-facing walking stride; 10-12 settle into the walk loop first contact pose. Whole fox remains in place; no canvas translation. No props.

Right-facing quadrupedal walking cycle in place with all FOUR legs moving correctly. Frame 1 near front paw forward in ground contact, opposite rear paw forward; frames 2-3 weight passes over these paws; 4-6 swing the opposite diagonal pair forward; frame 7 opposite contact; 8-9 passing; 10-12 return toward first contact. Small shoulder/hip motion and three distinct tails gently counter-swing. No body translation, no sliding planted paws, no props. Last frame connects to first.

Start at the exact walk first contact pose, near front paw forward. Frames 1-4 shorten stride and place lifted paws; 5-8 bring all four paws to the calm standing positions; 9-12 settle three tails and body into the exact attentive idle standing pose. Remain in place. No props.

Begin seated neutral with both front paws on the baseline and no props. Frames 2-4 reach one paw behind the hip and bring a small rolled ivory scroll visibly into view; 5-8 place and unroll it in front between paws; 9-12 lower head to study the open scroll. Short indigo rollers and abstract ink marks only. End in the read loop first pose. Three tails remain distinct. No collar or clothing.

Seated right-three-quarter fox studying the SAME small unrolled ivory scroll with short indigo rollers on baseline before his front paws. Frames 1-4 eyes track slowly along abstract ink marks; 5-6 blink; 7-9 small thoughtful head tilt; 10-12 return toward first study pose. Scroll and paws remain stable. Tail tips gently curl. No scroll text, no new objects. Last frame joins first.

Begin in the read loop first pose, studying an unrolled ivory scroll with short indigo rollers. Frames 2-4 lift head; 5-8 roll scroll closed with both front paws; 9-10 lift and visibly tuck scroll behind hip until hidden; 11-12 return paws and head to the exact seated neutral reference with no visible props. Three tails remain distinct.

Begin exact bare-neck standing neutral with no costume. Frames 2-4 reach behind hip and bring out a folded red vest; 5-7 visibly slip front paws through the open vest; 8-10 bring out a straw hat with red band and place between ears; 11-12 settle into upright friendly adventurer ready pose. Temporarily rear on hind paws for dressing, keeping hind paws planted, return stable. Fox anatomy, three tails and markings stay unchanged. No buttons with logos or lettering.

Kō wearing straw hat with red band and open red vest, balanced in friendly fox adventurer ready stance. Frames 1-3 grin and tip hat with near front paw; 4-5 draw that paw back; 6-8 perform one playful elastic paw punch to the RIGHT, extending foreleg to about twice normal reach but safely inside cell; 9-10 retract the foreleg; 11-12 return toward first ready pose. Explicit Luffy/One Piece reference through costume and rubbery punch. Keep fox head, ears, paws, fur, exactly three tails. No human hands. Body stays anchored. Last frame connects to first.

Begin in the adventurer loop first ready pose wearing straw hat with red band and open red vest. Frames 2-4 lift hat off head and visibly tuck behind hip; 5-8 slip front paws out of red vest, fold it; 9-10 visibly stow it behind hip; 11-12 return to the exact bare-neck four-pawed standing neutral reference with no costume or props. Keep fox anatomy and exactly three tails throughout.

additionalPilotTransitions.action: Begin exact standing neutral on four paws. Frames 2-4 bend rear legs, 5-8 lower rump slowly while front paws remain planted, 9-12 settle into the exact seated neutral reference. Three tails retain their distinct fan and slowly settle. No props.

Begin exact seated neutral with front paws planted. Frames 2-4 lean slightly forward, 5-8 extend hind legs and lift rump, 9-12 settle into exact four-pawed standing neutral. Three tails lift and settle without changing count. No props.
